On 11 November at 11:11 AM, one wave of kindness will travel through 38 time zones in 26 hours, and you are part of it.

It begins in Kiritimati, where the day starts first, and moves west with the clock until it reaches the last islands of the Pacific. Along the way, broadcasters, schools, charities and city councils in dozens of countries have been invited to join in.

Wherever you are, 11:11 AM your time is your moment. Do one kind thing for someone, then pass it on.

Join the wave at PassKindnessForward.com (link in bio).

Music: "Pásalo Pa'Lante" by Sie7e with Choco Orta.

#PassKindnessForward #Kindness

El 11 de noviembre a las 11:11 a.m., una ola de bondad cruzará 38 zonas horarias en 26 horas, y tú eres parte de ella.

Empieza en Kiritimati, donde el día llega primero, y avanza hacia el oeste con el reloj hasta las últimas islas del Pacífico. En el camino pasa por Puerto Rico, donde nació Pásalo Pa'lante, y por emisoras, escuelas y organizaciones de decenas de países invitadas a unirse.

Donde estés, a las 11:11 a.m. de tu hora te toca a ti: haz algo bueno por alguien y pásalo pa'lante.

Únete a la ola en PasaloPalante.com

Música: «Pásalo Pa'Lante», de Sie7e con Choco Orta.

#PásaloPaLante #PassKindnessForward

On 11 November at 11:11 AM local time, a wave of kindness will travel around the world, one time zone at a time.

It starts in Kiritimati, where the day begins first, and follows the clock west through 38 time zones over 26 hours. Broadcasters, schools, universities, charities and public offices along the route have been invited to mark the moment with a simple act of kindness.

If your organization would like to take part, it only asks for a minute at 11:11 AM in your time zone: one kind act, shared and passed on. You can join at PassKindnessForward.com

Music: "Pásalo Pa'Lante" by Sie7e with Choco Orta.
